description: Use when the rep has an upcoming on-site or virtual client visit/meeting where they need to present a proposal or solution to one or more stakeholders — and they need help preparing before, navigating during, and following up after. Triggers include '下周要去客户拜访', '帮我准备提案演示', '客户约了 30/60 分钟会', '怎么准备拜访', '拜访现场怎么应对反对', '临走怎么定下一步', '拜访完怎么复盘', 'visit proposal', 'customer pitch meeting', 'on-site presentation', 'executive briefing prep', 'pre-visit brief', 'field presentation'. Do NOT use for product elevator pitch only, proposal document/Word/PDF generation, PPT layout, demo scripts, single-meeting-only objection deep-dive across many calls, post-call structured debrief, or deal progression/closing (use clinch-progression-strategy).
